title: Japanese-language Wiktionary raw Wiktextract snapshot
source_scope: The raw Japanese-edition Wiktionary extract contains hundreds of languages. This Change Unit targets Modern Japanese (ja) and Classical Japanese (ojp). All source lines are counted; all target rows are preserved exactly after decompression; non-target rows are indexed rather than treated as Japanese lexical data.

license.name: CC BY-SA 4.0 / GFDL
license.dataset_license_note: kaikki.org states that extracted Wiktionary data is made available under the same licenses as Wiktionary (CC BY-SA and GFDL). Reuse in this pack follows CC BY-SA 4.0 requirements.
license.attribution: Retain Japanese Wiktionary source page URL per normalized record, plus dataset/upstream/source-version metadata; indicate that normalization modified the original structured extract.

semantic_policy.meaning_evidence: Only non-empty Wiktionary sense glosses are accepted as lexical meaning evidence in this source adapter.
semantic_policy.missing_gloss: Preserve the target source row and emit needs-evidence unresolved inventory; never synthesize a meaning.
semantic_policy.runtime: Reference pack only. No automatic Decision Ledger approval or Runtime promotion.
